text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $84k with minimal daily movement, while Ethereum is showing slightly more upside at $2,680, suggesting modest risk appetite in the majors. The Fear & Greed index has shifted sharply into greed territory over the past week, yet Bitcoin's dominance at 58.6% and relatively light volume of $105B indicate the rally lacks broad conviction—altcoins like SOL and BNB are outpacing both majors. The market sentiment has warmed considerably, but the narrow participation and flat Bitcoin action suggest traders remain cautious about sustainability at these levels.
